title: Chapter 422: The Deserted City Opens
content:
Chapter 422: The Deserted City Opens

"Okay, don't talk nonsense anymore. I need you to set up a big array for me, the big one."

Lu Xue spoke directly.

"It's big, how big is that?"

Zhen Qingyang said in confusion.

Lu Xue looked at Zhen Qingyang and said seriously: "The kind that can cover the entire Chaos Realm."

Cover the entire Chaos Realm!

Zhen Qingyang was stunned for a moment, then laughed loudly, "Of course there is no problem."

"But,"

Zhen Qingyang rubbed his hands and reached out to Lu Xue and said, "This is a matter of money."

As we all know, the formation path is extremely wide-ranging. Generally, there are some formations within forces with some background, especially the defensive formation, which are only opened at the moment of life and death.

And once it is turned on, it is burning money.

Therefore, the formation path is extremely expensive.

As long as a formation master like Zhi Qingyang has enough resources and time, he can basically create a formation no matter how big it is.

And Lu Xue, haha, what she lacks the most is resources.

"I will ask the people from Huangcheng to cooperate with you, don't let me down."

Lu Xue threw a ring to Zhen Qingyang, left this sentence, and then left directly.

After taking the ring, Zhen Qingyang immediately felt the resources contained in it. At this moment, his hands couldn't help trembling.

Immediately afterwards, an excitement arose from the bottom of my heart.

As a master of formation, he is naturally obsessed with formation. For example, a large formation covering the entire Chaos Realm, he has never tried it, but even if he hasn't tried it, he is still very confident. This time, The attainment of formation will inevitably be further improved.

After Lu Xue left Zhen Qingyang's residence, she returned to the city lord's mansion.

"Xiaoqing."

Lu Xue called out softly, and Ao Qing came out.

"My master, is there anything I want me to do?"

The battle is about to happen, and Ao Qing knows that he can no longer be idle.

Lu Xue nodded slightly and said, "Take Bai Ling back to the Heavenly Demon Clan and integrate the power of the Heavenly Demon Clan."

Hearing this, Ao Qing hesitated a little, "My Lord, is this necessary? Although the Heavenly Demon Clan is not weak in the Chaos Realm, what we have to face is the land of the gods, which can fight against the land of the gods. I'm afraid that in the Chaos Realm, only our wasteland city can deal with it."

Ao Qing's words make sense, but Lu Xue also understands this.

What Lu Xue was worried about was what if the people in Huangcheng could not come back in time by then? It would be a while for a while.

All she could do was to gather all the powers of the Chaos Realm and resist the land of the gods.

When their main force comes back, they can fight back all the way and attack Huanglong!

After a while, a weak and slim figure came from a distance.

"I have met Senior Lu Xue, Lord Ao Qing."

Lu Xue's eyes were placed on Bai Ling, and after a while, he nodded slightly.

Bai Ling has recovered well in the deserted city these days, and after obtaining Ao Qing’s pure Heavenly Demon bloodline, she can be said to have been reborn and her qualifications have been improved to the next level. If she is given enough time, she will definitely lead the Heavenly Demon Clan in time. brilliant.

But now, there is not much time left.

This land of gods came so quickly that they didn't prepare time at all.

Of course, if Lu Daosheng hadn't sent the news back, they wouldn't even know that the Land of Gods would take the lead and call him directly.

From this we can also see that the gap between the Chaos Realm and the Land of the Gods is quite large.

After explaining some things to Bai Ling, Ao Qing took Bai Ling away from the deserted city and headed towards the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Standing there, Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing leaving, and her calm expression suddenly became a little angry.

She looked up at the sky, her eyes shining through the sky, and she saw the black hole outside the sky staring at the Chaos Realm.

After watching for a moment, Lu Xue suddenly became a little confused again.

"What's wrong."

Lu Xue murmured, then broke through the space and came directly to the sky.

Before leaving, Lu Daosheng set up a defensive barrier for the Chaos Realm, and no alien could enter without his permission.

Lu Xue came close to her, felt it for a moment, and suddenly laughed.

"Dad, you really have it."

The backhand left by Lu Daosheng is indeed gradually weakening, but this is not what Lu Xue pays attention to.

If this does not gradually become weaker, then there will be a problem. At that time, they only need to shrink in the Chaos Realm and not come out, and the land of the gods will have no choice but to deal with them.

But that is definitely not what Lu Daosheng wants to see.

And the reason why Lu Xue really laughs is because time goes by.

That's right, the flow rate of time in the Chaos Realm is different from that in the outside world, which is something Lu Daosheng often makes.

Now, Lu Daosheng has used this move again.

It seems that Lu Daosheng had expected this day long ago, so he left many tricks.

So, now there is more time to prepare in the Chaos Realm.

Lu Xue estimated that it had been about ten years.

Has it been more than ten years? There are not many things for the Chaos Realm today.

Some powerful people in the Supreme Realm sometimes go into seclusion for more than ten years at a time.

But the deserted city is different. The deserted city has rich resources. As long as you are willing to work hard, you can really cultivate many strong people in ten years.

Afterwards, Lu Xue returned to the deserted city and released a new news.

In the next ten years, the Huangcheng will be open to the entire Chaos Realm creatures.

Although many strict rules have been issued, this is simply great news for the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm.

For a time, countless strong men from all over the world set off, carried their bags, and rushed towards the direction of the deserted city.

At this time, in a forest in a certain mountain in the Chaos Realm, a young man crossed his legs and closed his eyes, with a strong breath.

At this time, a piece of news came into his ears, which made him look very happy.

"Wild City, isn't that a legendary holy land?"

The boy licked the corner of his mouth and showed a confident smile, "With my talent, if I go to the deserted city, I will definitely gain something. When the war comes, I will have more self-protection."

"Maybe I can still protect my sister then."

The boy was Bai Xu who had disappeared for a long time.

At this time, a voice suddenly came from the bracelet on Bai Xu's wrist, "Boy, Huangcheng is a good place. At that time, I might be able to restore my soul and reunite my body."

Hearing this voice, Bai Xu nodded, "Don't worry, senior, you have taught me so many skills, you will definitely repay you well."

Bai Xu's words made the mysterious voice very satisfied, "Haha, you have a conscience. It is really God's pity for my clan to have a genius like you."

Then, Bai Xu cleaned up and set off directly to target the deserted city.

Similarly, the geniuses and monsters from all ethnic groups around the world also began to gather towards the deserted city.

This mysterious super power is finally exposed to the eyes of the world.
